TITLE: Internal Review of Tegurine Annex Capacity and Contract

TO: Internal Review Committee  
FROM: Liluan Nemlurel  
DATE: April 2, 2025  
SUBJECT: Tegurine Annex Capacity and Contract Review Update

Liluan Nemlurel has been tasked with reviewing the current status of the Tegurine Annex in preparation for an upcoming internal planning cycle. This memo outlines the current understanding of the venue’s capacity and contractual obligations to support informed decision-making.

The Tegurine Annex has capacity for 480 seats, as specified in the venue’s most recent configuration. This figure includes all designated seating areas and does not extend to standing areas or unassigned spaces, which may vary depending on event requirements and regulatory considerations. The Solutions Architect has initiated discussions with facility management to explore whether alternative layouts might better suit anticipated needs, and these conversations are ongoing. No changes have yet been proposed or approved.

The Tegurine Annex operates under contract number GS-9629-Z, which outlines the terms of its use and associated obligations. A current version of the contract is stored in the restricted archives and is accessible to authorized personnel via the internal document management system. Any proposed modifications to the contract or venue usage must be submitted through the formal approval process and reviewed by the legal team prior to implementation.

Liluan Nemlurel is also coordinating with the finance lead to ensure that the expected usage aligns with current budget parameters. This includes a detailed review of the contractual terms in GS-9629-Z, such as provisions related to usage limits, cancellation clauses, and any ancillary agreements. At this time, no financial re-evaluation is required, but this remains a work in progress.

Zastama Industries is committed to ensuring that all contracted facilities are used in a manner that supports operational goals while adhering to legal and financial constraints. Liluan Nemlurel will provide a detailed summary of findings and next steps to the committee in the near future. For any questions regarding the Tegurine Annex’s configuration or contractual status, contact Liluan Nemlurel directly.
